evidence.quote: The Green-and-black Poison Dart Frogs primarily thrive on a diet of miniature live insects and other arthropods.
A staple diet can consist of fruit flies supplemented with various other live prey. This could include aphids, springtails, bean beetles, rice flour beetles, small fly larvae, and pinhead crickets.

evidence.value: Insectes capturés dans la nature; insectes exposés à des produits de jardinage
evidence.quote: We do not recommend feeding wild caught insects as these can harbor harmful bacteria. They may also have come in contact with gardening chemicals, making them poisonous for your Frogs.
Feeding frequency varies with the frog's age.
